title: Cross-League Training Augmentation: WNBA Data to Expand NBA Model Training Set

source_paper.title: Machine Learning for Basketball Game Outcomes: NBA and WNBA Leagues
source_paper.key_finding: CNN achieves Brier=0.221 on NBA/WNBA combined dataset — matches our fleet best 0.22012. Multi-league training demonstrated valid for basketball outcome prediction.

proposal.hypothesis: Adding WNBA historical game data to the NBA training cache will expand the training set from ~9,551 to ~15,000+ games, reducing overfitting and improving generalization of tree-based GA models, particularly for low-frequency NBA game patterns.
proposal.mechanism: WNBA seasons share basketball fundamentals (team form, home advantage, rest days, point differentials) with NBA. Features derived from these patterns are transferable. The GA's feature selection will naturally weight WNBA-sourced features if they improve CV Brier.
implementation: 1. Source WNBA game data from Basketball-Reference or stats.wnba.com API (similar schema to NBA)
2. Generate feature vectors using existing engine.py (categories applicable to both leagues)
3. Add league_indicator binary feature to allow model to learn NBA vs WNBA differences
5. Test on S22 first (freshest island, least risk from cache change)
proposal.risk: MODERATE — WNBA games may introduce distribution shift. Mitigation: keep WNBA weight at 0.5× NBA (sample_weight parameter in sklearn). If Brier improves on S22 after 100 gens, port to S15/S18.
proposal.expected_brier_delta: -0.002 to -0.005 (extrapolated from dataset size scaling laws in NBA ML literature)
proposal.blocked_by: engine-parity-sync (P40) — must sync engine.py first so WNBA features compute consistently across islands

secondary_finding.title: CNN Brier=0.221 Ceiling Confirmed
secondary_finding.significance: Deep learning CNN matches our GA fleet best 0.22012. This is the 3rd independent confirmation of the ~0.220 ceiling for sequential NBA game prediction using game-level features (previous: ACM 2025 DL 0.221, MDPI Uncertainty 2026 RNN 0.221). Our tree-based GA at 0.22012 is competitive with DL without GPU. Pareto best 0.21841 already below DL ceiling — this is the path forward.
secondary_finding.implication: Focus should remain on feature quality (engine parity, FEC data) and calibration (LR, MC dropout proxy via CalibratedClassifierCV) rather than model architecture changes.
